verdict.rationale: Muse documents generating insights and suggestions from user-linked data inside the product. It flags forgotten charges and audits subscriptions from linked finances, builds dashboards to find patterns in sleep data, adjusts fitness plans day by day from shared health data, and sends notifications when something needs attention. All of this comes from first-party marketing and app-store copy rather than in-depth documentation or hands-on testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, detailed docs on how insights are generated and surfaced across data sources.
